subject: Problem Starting Rattle from RStudio, Windows

messages.author: e145b4ac66f52bdf
messages.subject: Problem Starting Rattle from RStudio, Windows
parts:
I am having a problem starting Rattle (2.6.17) from RStudio (Version 0.95.262, Windows 7).  When I try to initiate Rattle from the console, I get this message:  

(rsession.exe:3120): Gtk-CRITICAL **: gtk_builder_add_from_file: assertion `filename != NULL' failed
Error in rattle() : attempt to apply non-function

I uninstalled Gtk, reinstalled it, and on the first run, Rattle started up.  I quit RStudio, started back up and got the error above again.  If I initiate from the regular R Console, it works.  Any ideas?

messages.author: 51ea28fc190ac537
messages.subject: Re: Problem Starting Rattle from RStudio, Windows
parts:
Thanks for the report.

I've just tried RStudio on Windows 7 with R 2.14.2 and all seems okay. 

Could it be you saved the workspace and that might be interfering with Rattle in some way? Check for a .RData file being loaded by RStudio and perhaps rename it to something else to avoid it being loaded and test starting rattle again.

Regards,
Graham

messages.author: fb4c80c989612264
messages.subject: Problem loading data / windows 7 machine 64 bit install
parts:
I have a similar problem on a windows 7 machine with 64 bit install. In my case, I am able to initiate and bring up the rattle console in both Rstudio and R, however I am unable to load data (i.e. select an excel 2007 file and press the execute button). I get the following message in the pop up window. Greatly appreciate if somebody can help me resolve this. The RODBC package is confirmed to be installed.
 
 
An error occured in the following command:
require(RODBC, quietly=TRUE)
con <- odbcConnectExcel2007("C:/Users/Anil Gandhi/Documents/Financial/.....xlsx")
crs$dataset <- sqlFetch(con, "Sheet1")
odbcClose(con)
crs$dataset.
The error message was:
Error in sqlFetch(con, "Sheet1") :
  first argument is not an open RODBC channel
 
 
The rattleInfo() gives the following response
